purpose: Teach: 堅持/不均衡/商会/公訴/報い/困窮/参る/折り合い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、信念を、絶対、堅持、絶対、してきたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding days, your father held firm to his principles with absolute conviction. That's what I'm asking of you.
lines.style: Steady, measured opening. Weight behind each phrase. Patriarch's voice — not raised, but present. Pauses between ideas like each one matters. Quiet authority, no performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、市場の、絶対、不均衡、絶対、見極めて、絶対、進めてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've stayed true to discerning real imbalances in the market and moving forward with that clarity. I'm grateful for that inheritance.
lines.style: Formal respect, but alive in it — not recitation. Direct eye contact implied. Spine straight. Each concept lands with intention. The gratitude is genuine, not ceremonial.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代の、本気で、絶対、商会、絶対、名、絶対、誇り、絶対、持っていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father's trading company carried that name with pride. He didn't let it fall to carelessness.
lines.style: Soft but grounded. A breath of memory. The words slow slightly on 「名」and 「誇り」 — the weight of legacy. Not melancholy, but respectful of what was. Slight trailing quality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、本気で、絶対、公訴、絶対、を恐れず、絶対、信念を貫いたと聞きました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I heard that my father stood by his beliefs even when prosecution loomed. That courage — I carry it forward.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not defensive — owning it. Steady tone, no wavering. The word 「信念を貫いた」sits heavy with understood consequences. Respectful hum beneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの努力の、本気で、絶対、報い、絶対、お前が、絶対、引き継いでいるぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father's work — you're honoring it by taking it up. You're carrying what he built.
lines.style: Gaze steady, voice steady. A charge, but wrapped in warmth. Not commanding — affirming. Slow, deliberate pacing. The voice of someone who has watched and is satisfied.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、困窮、絶対、する家庭、絶対、支援、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've continued to support families in hardship. That practice is sacred to us.
lines.style: Tender without fragility. The voice softens fractionally on 「困窮する家庭」. Not emotional — something deeper. Quiet certainty. The duty is love-bound.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、お得意様の元に、絶対、自ら、絶対、参る、絶対、姿勢、絶対、貫いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father walked directly to his best clients himself. He never hid behind rank. He modeled dignity in that humility.
lines.style: Wistful admiration. Slower pace. The image of the father — 「自ら参る」 — is painted with respect. Slight warmth on 「姿勢」. The voice honors something lost and chose to keep it alive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、本気で、絶対、相手と、絶対、折り合い、絶対、つける、絶対、知恵、絶対、私の手本です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father taught me that the real wisdom is knowing how to meet the other person halfway. That's been my compass.
lines.style: Closing with quiet resolve. Warm but grounded. The voice softens on 「知恵」 and 「手本」— not sentimental, but acknowledging what matters. Slight pause at the end, like settling something important.
